intent: Expand all seven approved overhead actions from twelve to thirty-two genuinely generated poses per facing; preserve combat timing, identity, effects and previous versions.
bodyPrompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: production TOP-DOWN pixel RPG sprite animation sheet.
Input Image 1: existing twelve animation poses to expand. Input Image 2: approved idle stance/costume reference. Preserve this exact character, palette, scale, overhead camera and map facing. Change ONLY temporal pose density.
OUTPUT: EXACTLY 32 genuinely different successive poses in an EIGHT-COLUMN by FOUR-ROW grid, preferably 2048x1024. Row1=frames01-08, row2=09-16, row3=17-24, row4=25-32. One continuous action, not four repetitions. Equal square cells with no external margin. Full silhouette centered at the same hip/ground pivot (50%,68%) in each cell, constant absolute body size. At least 12% transparent padding on every side of each sprite.
Style: crisp hand-crafted pixel clusters matching reference, ivory great helm with dark visor, gold/bronze thorn crown, battered ivory-gold plate, dark joints, ragged ivory cape with rust hem, white quiver, recurved bow and straight sword. Do not redesign armor or introduce a face.
Camera fixed HIGH OVERHEAD 65-degree orthographic: helmet roof/top planes visible, foreshortened body and boots, cape on map plane. NOT eye-level portrait or side-scroller.
32 poses use SMALL coherent in-between movements. Keep torso registered; no whole-character sliding, rescaling, random turning, flickering costume or huge cape motion. Seamless loop back to first pose except death. No cloned/repeated identical frames.
Genuinely transparent background and alpha between every sprite. No floor, cast shadow, effects, arrows in flight, numbers, letters, grid lines, captions or watermark.

export.registration: Fixed scale/translation per action/facing relative to approved v4 rest stance; shared source row/column packing correction; no per-frame resizing or invented poses.

Input Image 1: existing twelve animation poses to expand. Input Image 2: approved idle stance/costume reference. Preserve this exact character, palette, scale, overhead camera and map facing. Change ONLY temporal pose density.
OUTPUT: EXACTLY 32 genuinely different successive poses in an EIGHT-COLUMN by FOUR-ROW grid, preferably 2048x1024. Row1=frames01-08, row2=09-16, row3=17-24, row4=25-32. One continuous action, not four repetitions. Equal square cells with no external margin. Full silhouette centered at the same hip/ground pivot (50%,68%) in each cell, constant absolute body size. At least 12% transparent padding on every side of each sprite.
Style: crisp hand-crafted pixel clusters matching reference, ivory great helm with dark visor, gold/bronze thorn crown, battered ivory-gold plate, dark joints, ragged ivory cape with rust hem, white quiver, recurved bow and straight sword. Do not redesign armor or introduce a face.
Camera fixed HIGH OVERHEAD 65-degree orthographic: helmet roof/top planes visible, foreshortened body and boots, cape on map plane. NOT eye-level portrait or side-scroller.
32 poses use SMALL coherent in-between movements. Keep torso registered; no whole-character sliding, rescaling, random turning, flickering costume or huge cape motion. Seamless loop back to first pose except death. No cloned/repeated identical frames.
Genuinely transparent background and alpha between every sprite. No floor, cast shadow, effects, arrows in flight, numbers, letters, grid lines, captions or watermark.
ALL32FRAMES face UP toward screen top. See BACK and TOP of helmet and embroidered cape. NO face/visor on the back, never turn toward viewer.
Animation:
ONE SKYWARD BOW SHOT and recovery.01-04 low guard then begin raising bow;05-08 raise diagonally upward;09-12 tilt skyward with progressive draw;13-16 full skyward draw, arrow stays on string until17.17 FIRST release, no airborne arrow drawn;18-20 tiny recoil;21-24 settle and lower;25-28 bow down;29-32 restore original low guard. Keep map facing fixed, foreshorten raised bow seen from overhead. No rain/particles/projectiles.
